foregroundRationaleTitle: Allow location while using the app
foregroundRationaleBody: VanSathi uses your location to set school and pickup pins and share the van location during a trip.
backgroundRationaleBody: This app collects location data to keep an active school-van trip visible to linked parents, detect nearby stops and school arrival, and save recent route history when the app is closed or not in use. Tracking starts when the driver starts a trip and stops when it ends. The van's latest location is shared with linked parents; sampled route points are kept for up to 30 days. Choose Allow all the time in the next system prompt.

privacyBody: VanSathi shares the driver's live location with linked parents only while a trip is active. Your account uses your verified phone number to link you with your child's van.
privacyLocation: Trip locations and status events are used to show progress and send alerts. Sampled route history is automatically deleted after 30 days.
privacyRetention: You can request account and linked data deletion in Settings. Deleting a driver account also removes that van's records, and requires the driver to end any active trip first.
privacyMapProvider: When a map is shown, the configured map provider receives map-tile requests for the visible area and may process network/device details under its own privacy terms. Map styles are accepted only over HTTPS.
privacyChoice: You can change notification choices in Settings and stop location sharing by ending the trip. Contact your van operator for privacy or deletion help.
privacyPolicyLocation: Ask your van operator for a copy of the full privacy notice.

deleteAccountComplete: Your account and data were deleted.
batterySteps_xiaomi: Open Settings → Apps → VanSathi → Battery saver and choose No restrictions. In Security → Permissions → Autostart, allow VanSathi to start automatically. Names can differ by MIUI version.
batterySteps_vivo: In Settings → Apps → VanSathi → Battery, allow background activity and choose unrestricted use. If your phone has Auto-start or App launch settings, allow VanSathi there too. Names vary by model.
batterySteps_samsung: Open Settings → Battery → Background usage limits → Never auto sleeping apps, then add VanSathi. Also allow background activity in Settings → Apps → VanSathi → Battery.
